info.title: AMcards.com Universal API
info.description: Send greeting cards, manage contacts, and trigger AMcards campaigns

post.description: Creates a new contact in AMcards.com.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

addressLine1.description: Primary street address for the contact.

addressLine2.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit.

birthDay.description: Birth day value used for AMcards reminder/contact data.

birthMonth.description: Birth month value used for AMcards reminder/contact data.

birthYear.description: Birth year value used for AMcards reminder/contact data.

city.description: City for the contact mailing address.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the contact mailing address.

groups[].description: List of AMcards group resource URIs. Use an empty list when the contact should not be assigned to a group.

notes.description: Freeform note stored on the AMcards contact.

owner.description: AMcards owner resource URI such as `/.api/v1/user/47054/`.

postalCode.description: Postal code for the contact mailing address.

state.description: State or province for the contact mailing address.
